bounded_host_request.command: set -eu; log=$(mktemp); trap 'rm -f "$log"' EXIT; if git archive f3493e866bd0ddc002c8fc0468cbd79e61b732b7 | docker build --pull=false --progress=plain -f artifacts/bot/deploy/Dockerfile.gaybbs -t gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:candidate-f3493e8 - >"$log" 2>&1; then exit 0; fi; if grep -Eqi 'failed to read dockerfile|Dockerfile.*not found|failed to calculate checksum|COPY failed|file not found' "$log"; then exit 81; elif grep -Eqi 'ERR_PNPM_OUTDATED_LOCKFILE|ERR_PNPM_LOCKFILE' "$log"; then exit 82; elif grep -Eqi 'ERR_PNPM_FETCH|ERR_PNPM_META_FETCH|ECONNREFUSED|ETIMEDOUT|network is unreachable|TLS handshake' "$log"; then exit 83; elif grep -Eqi 'corepack.*error|Cannot find matching keyid|corepack.*fail|npm error|CERT_HAS_EXPIRED' "$log"; then exit 84; elif grep -Eqi 'error TS[0-9]+|Build failed with|Cannot resolve|Could not resolve' "$log"; then exit 85; elif grep -Eqi 'no space left|disk quota' "$log"; then exit 86; else exit 87; fi
